signals.finding: Ships to 8200 NW 25th St, Ste 104 #FWD-55821, Doral, not the buyer's PayPal address. Seller Protection generally covers only the address on the transaction.
The parcel is addressed to R. Vance c/o ParcelBridge Forwarding, not the PayPal payer Tomas Reyes.
The shipping address looks like a package forwarder.
The buyer's PayPal account is unverified.
The buyer paid for Overnight express.
Countermove network: 2 other shops reported this PayPal account (item not received, unauthorised) after their evidence contradicted the claim.

verdict.headline: This high-value, unverified overnight order ships to a package forwarder under a different name and is flagged by the Countermove network for prior disputed claims.
actions: Cancel and fully refund the payment immediately due to unverified status, high-value overnight forwarder shipping, and Countermove network fraud alerts.
Do not ship to the package forwarder address or to a different recipient name (R. Vance) that does not match the PayPal payer.
